scene: The lizard merchant rattles a shiny brass key. Which path beckons?
picture: Along a tiled market floor, a wooden chest sits on the far left. The player in yellow raincoat, green boots, and red umbrella stands left of centre facing forward. In the centre, a lizard merchant holds up a brass key. An arched tunnel glowing with blue mushrooms waits on the far right.
shown: a gleaming brass key held out by the lizard merchant in the centre
a locked wooden chest bound in vines sitting on the far left
a brick archway glowing with blue mushrooms on the far right
